{{Otheruses|Chief of Staff}}
The '''Chief of Defense Staff''' was the professional head of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the event that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was declared unfit for duty, the Chief of Defense Staff was to take command of the Grand Army until a new Chancellor was elected.
